Our Culture and Values

What makes an Axonian an Axonian?

Our values are the very essence of what makes an Axonian an Axonian. They’re a reflection of everything we embody. Everything we stand for, believe in, and value as a global group of individuals working together to achieve audacious goals.

BENEFITS AND PERKS

We've
got your back

Above all, we want to see you succeed — which is why we invest in our people with competitive compensation and benefits, growth opportunities, community-building, and so much more.

Great perks, competitive benefits

  • Flexible, remote first culture.
  • Option for fully funded health insurance plans for employees in the U.S, Israel, the U.K., and Portugal.
  • Stock options for all full time employees.
  • Equity refresh opportunities.
  • Global "unwind weekends" several times a year to rest and recharge.

Personal & Career Growth

  • New role opportunities & stretch challenges.
  • 1:1 coaching for people managers.
  • A focus on feedback for growth.
  • Al tools for real-time learning.
  • Individual development budgets.
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to build community.

Top-Notch Family Leave Options

  • 17 weeks parental leave for primary caregiver and 8 weeks for secondary caregiver.
  • Additional time off for marriage and children's milestones, like first day of school and graduation.
  • Extended bereavement leave.
  • Time off for birth of grandchildren.

Axonius For Good

  • Community partnerships.
  • Charitable gifting options for birthdays, anniversaries, other milestones.
  • Volunteer time off.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Inclusion Breeds Innovation

Axonius is committed to creating a diverse team at every level, fostering an environment where inclusion breeds innovation. Our differences not only make us stronger — they catalyze our growth. Axonius Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) are voluntarily-led by employees who share or support a characteristic. Our ERGs exist to foster diversity and inclusivity, promote personal and career development, ignite real change across the organization, and create a safe work environment where employees can show up as their whole selves.

where we are

Axonius Office & Employee Locations

Meet
The Axonians

At Axonius, growth is not just a goal it's our mission! We believe in fostering an environment where our employees can thrive and develop. Hear inspiring stories of personal and professional growth directly from our own Axonians.

Find your balance

Work from the office, your home, or a coffee shop

At Axonius, we believe in empowering our teams to do their best work in a way that suits them. That's why we offer a flexible work policy, allowing you to choose the environment that works best for you. Depending on your role, you may have the option to work from home, in one of our offices, or in a coffee shop. We believe in creating a culture of growth and flexibility, ensuring that Axonians can thrive wherever they are.
